person_note: The authorized opening extract uses sustained third-person narration and shifts focal attention among several characters without introducing a participating narrator. Interior Goodreads passages independently show the same external narration and access to characters' private thoughts. First-person forms occur in dialogue, while generalized you passages are aphoristic or free-indirect rather than sustained second-person narration. Two credible whole-book descriptions explicitly corroborate third-person omniscient or multi-viewpoint narration. No evidence indicates a sustained first- or second-person base section; the opening-only scope of the authorized extract is mitigated by the interior quotes and whole-book sources.
